text:
maria_cs: Hey team — kicking off OrionCorp dedicated bring-up tomorrow. Quick checklist + asks: final quota allocations, autoscale thresholds, planned load test window, and a short enablement for their SREs at 09:30 PT. Can ops confirm pool size and whether we can enable burst for the first 2h? Need final numbers by 18:00 PT today.

sam_ops: We have 16 GPUs reserved (4xA100-80 per pool). Baseline throughput target set to 80 rps per GPU. Burst is OK +30% for first 2h but we'll require KV cache prewarm.

ryan_eng: Request traffic profile (seq lengths, p95 target). Recommend initial autoscale rule: `tokens_per_sec > 5000 for 2m => scale +1` and `tokens_per_sec < 2000 for 5m => scale -1`. Keep warmup window 10m.

alyssa_se: I can run the 09:30 PT enablement. Sending invite to Orion SREs now. I'll include a 15-min ops runbook, a short demo of fallback model variants, and the feedback form link.

ken_oncall: Oncall ack. Alerts to add: `error_rate > 1% for 5m`, `queue_depth > 1000`, and `p95_latency > 300ms for 10m`. I'll attach pager rotation.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled 08:00 PT tomorrow: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 15m, health checks every 30s.

maria_cs: Renewal note — AMs flagged renewal risk as "medium" due to latency sensitivity. If p95 > 300ms during warmup or first day, we'll surface in QBR. Please prioritize latency stability.

sam_ops: Plan for shadow load: 30m run, ~60k total reqs (traffic shape attached). Run command for ops: ```./tools/loadtest --profile orion --duration 30m --targets 60000``` We'll prewarm KV cache for 12m beforehand.

ryan_eng: Also pin model and quant profile for consistency: `orion-gpt-13b@v2` + `q4_0` for inference. If fallback needed use `orion-gpt-13b@v1` with lower concurrency.

alyssa_se: Post-run feedback capture: short survey + JIRA template. I'll paste the template in the onboarding doc and create a quick feedback board for Orion SREs.

maria_cs: TL;DR final check: pool=16 GPUs, burst=+30% for 2h, shadow load=30m/60k reqs, autoscale token rule as above, alerts set. I'll update the onboarding doc and ping AMs once ops confirms prewarm window. Thanks!
